projectDescription: A multi-language toolkit (Java and Node.js) for representing, manipulating, and generating spreadsheet-like data as JSON, including code generators that produce typed classes from JSON Schema.
keyFeatures: JSON representation of spreadsheet workbooks with sheets, tables, and lists
TypeScript/Node.js library (@org-quicko/sheet) for typed workbook manipulation
Java library (in.org.quicko.sheet:core) with Jackson-based JSON serialization
Node.js generator CLI with excel-to-schema, json-to-schema, and schema-to-objects commands
Java Maven plugin (schema-to-pojo goal) for generating POJOs from JSON Schema
XLSX import/export with automatic epoch date conversion
Sheet Tools browser app with visual schema builder and data visualizer
Metadata support on all workbook, sheet, and block nodes
publicApiSurface: Workbook (Node.js) — getSheets(), getSheet(index|name), addSheet(), replaceSheet(), removeSheet(), fromXlsx(), toXlsx()
Sheet (Node.js) — getBlocks(), getBlock(index|name), addBlock(), replaceBlock(), removeBlock()
Table (Node.js) — getHeader(), setHeader(), getRows(), getRow(), addRow(), addRows(), replaceRow(), removeRow(), getColumns(), popRow()
List (Node.js) — getItems(), getItem(key), addItem(), addItems(), replaceItem(), removeItem(index|key)
Item (Node.js) — getKey(), getValue(), getNumberValue(), getStringValue(), getBooleanValue(), equals()
SheetJsonEntityType enum — WORKBOOK, SHEET, TABLE, LIST, ISSUE_ROW, ISSUE_TABLE
Workbook (Java) — getSheets(), getSheet(int|String), addSheet(), replaceSheet(), removeSheet()
Sheet (Java) — getBlocks(), getBlock(int|String), addBlock(), replaceBlock(), removeBlock()
Table (Java) — getHeader(), setHeader(), getRows(), getRow(int), addRow(), addRows(), replaceRow(), removeRow()
List (Java) — getItems(), getItem(String|int), addItem(), replaceItem(), removeItem(int|String)
JsonMapper (Java) — Jackson ObjectMapper subclass with BigDecimal/BigInteger support
